# exception

`minidump.cpp` and `minidump.hpp` implement Windows exception minidump generation from `LPEXCEPTION_POINTERS` context.

## Contents

- [minidump.cpp](./minidump.cpp) exports `create_minidump`, combines `MiniDumpType` flags through `get_minidump_type`, writes dumps with `MiniDumpWriteDump`, and reads serialized bytes through `read_file`.
- [minidump.hpp](./minidump.hpp) declares `create_minidump(LPEXCEPTION_POINTERS exceptioninfo)` with `std::string` return type.

## API Surface

`create_minidump(const LPEXCEPTION_POINTERS exceptioninfo)` accepts exception context and returns a `std::string` containing the generated minidump result.

## Behavioral Contracts

- `get_minidump_type()` combines `MiniDumpIgnoreInaccessibleMemory`, `MiniDumpWithHandleData`, `MiniDumpScanMemory`, `MiniDumpWithProcessThreadData`, `MiniDumpWithFullMemoryInfo`, `MiniDumpWithThreadInfo`, and `MiniDumpWithUnloadedModules`.
- `get_temp_filename()` calls `GetTempPathA` and `GetTempFileNameA` with prefix `"Consolation -"`.
- `write_dump_to_temp_file()` creates a `FILE_FLAG_DELETE_ON_CLOSE` handle and terminates with exit code `123` after displaying `"Minidump Error"` when `MiniDumpWriteDump` fails.
- `read_file()` uses a `0x2000`-byte buffer and returns `{}` when `ReadFile` fails.
- `gsl::finally` closes the temporary handle after `create_minidump`.
- `dbghelp.lib` is required for `MiniDumpWriteDump`.
